package fixture.constructedactor

import framework.dsl.*

object Default extends Actor:
  val defaultOwn = action(this)
object Empty extends Actor(""):
  val emptyOwn = action(this)
object Named extends Actor("native-name"):
  val namedOwn = action(this)
object Outer:
  object Nested extends Actor:
    val nestedOwn = action(this)
object `Odd-name` extends Actor:
  val oddOwn = action(this)
trait Parent extends Actor
object Inherited extends Parent:
  val inheritedOwn = action(this)

object Actions:
  val defaultRef = action(Default)
  val emptyRef = action(Empty)
  val namedRef = action(Named)
  val system = action(Actor.system)
  val factory = action(Actor("fixture"))
  val emptyFactory = action(Actor(""))
  val factoryValue = Actor("alias")
  val factoryAlias = factoryValue
  val alias = action(factoryAlias)
  val record = Entity("record")
  val modified = action(Named).input[Boolean]("flag").results("Reply")
    .on(record).creates(record).example(false, "no")

def unchanged(s: Boolean): List[Step[Boolean, Boolean, Nothing]] = List(Step(true, s))
def flag(s: Boolean, value: Boolean): List[Step[Boolean, Boolean, Nothing]] =
  List(Step(value, s))
object Subject extends Machine[Boolean, Boolean, Nothing]:
  val init = false
  def end(s: Boolean): Boolean = s
  object rules extends Bindings(
    Default.defaultOwn ~> unchanged,
    Empty.emptyOwn ~> unchanged,
    Named.namedOwn ~> unchanged,
    Outer.Nested.nestedOwn ~> unchanged,
    `Odd-name`.oddOwn ~> unchanged,
    Inherited.inheritedOwn ~> unchanged,
    Actions.defaultRef ~> unchanged,
    Actions.emptyRef ~> unchanged,
    Actions.namedRef ~> unchanged,
    Actions.system ~> unchanged,
    Actions.factory ~> unchanged,
    Actions.emptyFactory ~> unchanged,
    Actions.alias ~> unchanged,
    Actions.modified ~> flag
  )
val progress = Subject.leadsTo("actors")(s => !s, s => s, 1)
